text: Appeal of Order to Comply (February 4, 2022) for 1520-1548 Warden Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (February 4, 2022) for 1520-1548 Warden Avenue, Folder No. 22 111165 PRS 00 IV, and, in doing so, granted an extension of time to July 29, 2022, and further directed that the Municipal Standards Officer, the appellant and the tenant meet to discuss the resolution of the Order to Comply (February 4, 2022) prior to that date.
